title: Use Groups and Permitted Uses — Residential, Commercial, and Community Facility
description: Overview of Use Groups in NYC zoning, with focus on §35-31 mixed building rules and permitted residential uses. Covers residential conversion provisions and commercial district use permissions.

use_group_summary.UG_I: Agriculture and Open Uses — permitted in most districts

conversion_rules.zr_15_01: All conversions to residences: permitted only in districts where residential is allowed by district regulations OR in M districts with authorization
conversion_rules.zr_35_31: Non-residential building existing on December 15, 1961 may be changed to residential use — floor area ratio regulations shall not apply to such change of use
conversion_rules.exception_note: Pre-1961 building conversion exempt from FAR limits — critical for adaptive reuse projects

commercial_use_rules.C1_overlay: Local retail: grocery, dry cleaner, restaurant, pharmacy, bank, retail ≤2500 sqft per establishment
commercial_use_rules.C2_overlay: Neighborhood retail and services: broader range of commercial uses
commercial_use_rules.C4_C6: Major commercial centers: offices, hotels, department stores, large retail
commercial_use_rules.M_districts: Commercial uses allowed per §42-00; manufacturing uses permitted per performance standards

community_facility_rules.r6_r12: Per ZR §24-11: community facility FAR shall not exceed residential FAR unless modified by special permit
community_facility_rules.commercial_districts: Community facility uses per §33-20; separate FAR applies
community_facility_rules.mixed_buildings: Community facility and residential in same building: per §35-33 for commercial districts

mixed_use_building_rules.zr_35_33: Commercial/community facility FAR + residential FAR each limited separately; total shall not exceed greatest single-use FAR
mixed_use_building_rules.floor_area_sharing: Where floor area is shared by multiple uses: attributed proportionally; floor area bonus applies to whichever use receives the bonus
mixed_use_building_rules.residential_conversion_exemption: Per §35-31: pre-1961 buildings converting to residential exempt from FAR cap

dob_filing_notes: Confirm permitted use group for district — check ZR §22-11 (residential), §32-00 (commercial C1-C6), §42-00 (manufacturing)
Conversion of pre-1961 building: document building existence date; FAR limits waived per §35-31
Mixed-use buildings: separate analysis for commercial and residential FAR/height requirements
If community facility + residential: verify FAR per §24-11 or §35-33
